6541.title: Desktop restore scheduling and redundant native menus
6541.rootCauseOneLine: Saved-window restoration awaits navigation inside a serial loop, and equivalent settings refreshes unconditionally replace the native menu.
6541.proposedFix: Overlap saved-window navigation while preserving result order; reuse equivalent native menus while refreshing callbacks and invalidating native checked-state actions.
6541.caveats: Owner-boundary tests repeated in two trusted checkouts; no live macOS verification. Unrelated packaging test fails on baseline and fixed code due to missing libglib-2.0.so.0.
